target_customer: Global businesses and AI agents needing banking, yield, cards and payments across 160 countries
problem: Businesses outside major banking hubs lack easy access to dollar accounts, cards and instant cross-border payments.
business_model: Fintech fees on payments, cards and yield products (stablecoin based)
product_category: Stablecoin neobank for businesses and agents

founders.name: Courtne Marland
founders.background_notes: GTM engineering and SMMA background; published four App Store apps.

founders.name: Henry Kwon
founders.background_notes: HackMIT and HackHarvard awards; US Congressional App Challenge winner 2025.

competitors.name: Catena Labs
competitors.what: AI-native financial institution for agents, co-founded by a Circle co-founder

technical_complexity.rationale: Needs banking partners, card issuing, compliance and stablecoin rails across many countries even for a small team.

defensibility.rationale: Licenses and bank partnerships could become a moat, but no evidence yet; funded rivals have larger war chests.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Funded stablecoin neobanks launched in 2025 and 2026; no IRBC specific outcome found.

market_need_then: Stablecoin supply and agent payments growing; claims of cost and access gaps for businesses in 160 countries come from the company, unverified.

identity.voice_and_tone: Finance as programmable money, chat and CLI access

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand found; name is an unexplained acronym.

outcome_analysis: IRBC is a three person New York company from Spring 2025 pitching a stablecoin based bank for businesses and AI agents. No funding, traction figures or exit were found, so the outcome is open; compliance burden and well funded rivals are the main risks.
notes: No funding found; this is not evidence of zero funding. Searches returned only other companies (Catena Labs, Augustus). Outcome search found no events. Name expansion unknown.
